description_en: Queries the details of a single storage object in OSS that is authorized for connection to Data Security Center
description_zh: 调用本接口查询数据安全中心连接授权的OSS的单个存储对象的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun sddp describe-oss-object-detail-v2 --lang zh_cn --id 12300 --service-region-id cn-hangzhou --bucket-name sddp-api-scan-demo --object-key dir1/test.png --template-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeOssObjectDetailV2

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh_cn. Valid values:

zh_cn: Simplified Chinese.
en_us: English (US)
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和返回消息的语言类型。默认值为zh_cn。取值

zh_cn：简体中文
en_us：英文（美国）
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the OSS storage object.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410152.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储对象的唯一标识ID。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410152.html接口获取ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The service region ID, which is the region ID of the bucket
parameters.help_zh: 服务地域ID，即Bucket所在的地域ID
parameters.name: service_region_id

parameters.help_en: The full name of the file stored in OSS
parameters.help_zh: 文件在OSS上存储的完整文件名
parameters.name: object_key

parameters.help_en:
The industry template ID.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2399296.html operation to obtain the industry template ID
parameters.help_zh:
行业模版ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2399296.html获取行业模板标识ID
parameters.name: template_id

OssObjectDetail.description_en: The details of the OSS storage object

BucketName.description_en: The name of the bucket to which the OSS storage object belongs

CategoryName.description_en: The parent category of the model

Id.description_en: The unique ID of the column object

ModelTagIds.description_en:
The data tags, separated by commas, such as 101,102. Valid values:
101: personal sensitive information.
102: personal information.
107: general information
ModelTagIds.description_zh:
数据标签，多个用逗号分隔，如101,102。取值：
101：个人敏感信息。
102：个人信息。
107：通用信息

Name.description_en: The name of the OSS storage object

ObjectAcl.description_en: The ACL of the file object

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the OSS storage object

RiskLevelId.description_en:
The risk level ID of the column data in the data asset table. Valid values:
1: N/A.
2: S1.
3: S2.
4: S3.
5: S4.

A return value less than or equal to 1 indicates N/A
RiskLevelId.description_zh:
数据资产表中列数据的风险等级ID。取值：
1：N/A。
2：S1。
3：S2。
4：S3。
5：S4。

返回值<=1，代表N/A
